app.title: KeyClean
app.tagline: Lock your keyboard and mouse while you clean them.
lock.target.mouseHint: With the mouse locked, Unlock now can't be clicked. Use Ctrl + Alt + K or wait for the timer.
status.complete: Cleaning complete. Everything is unlocked again.
endReason.hardDeadline: the safety time limit was reached.
endReason.endSession: Windows was signing out or shutting down.
endReason.sessionDisconnect: the Windows session was switched or disconnected.
endReason.engineError: something went wrong, so KeyClean released your input.
endReason.overlayLost: its lock screen was closed or hidden.
dev.capHint: Development build: every lock is capped at 15 seconds, with a 20-second safety limit.
devices.note.touchpad: Locked together with the mouse, except for gestures: two-finger scrolling, pinch, and three- and four-finger swipes still work during a lock.
devices.lockScope: A lock covers every connected keyboard, and every mouse and touchpad when you include them.
error.ipc: The window couldn't reach KeyClean's input engine.
error.engine_already_running: KeyClean's input engine is already running.
error.engine_stopped: KeyClean's input engine has stopped. Restart KeyClean to lock again.
error.already_locked: A lock is already in progress.
error.overlay_timeout: The lock screen didn't appear in time, so nothing was locked. Try again.
error.overlay_failed: KeyClean couldn't show its lock screen, so nothing was locked.
error.engine_start: KeyClean couldn't start its input engine.
error.hook_install: Windows didn't allow KeyClean to start the lock. Nothing was locked.
error.no_targets: Choose the keyboard, the mouse, or both before locking.
error.engine_failed: Something went wrong during the lock, so KeyClean ended it. Everything works again.
error.devices: KeyClean couldn't list your input devices.
error.device_watch: KeyClean can't tell when you plug in or unplug a device, so this list may be out of date.
error.hook_lost: Windows stopped KeyClean's keyboard lock early. Your keyboard works again.
error.chord_hook_lost: Windows stopped KeyClean's emergency shortcut, so KeyClean ended the lock. Your mouse works again.
error.mouse_hook_lost: Windows stopped KeyClean's mouse lock early, so KeyClean ended the lock. Everything works again.
notice.elevated_window: Typing reaches administrator windows during a lock.
notice.elevated_window_chord: Ctrl + Alt + K may not work while an administrator window is active.
notice.elevated_window_mouse: The mouse works in administrator windows during a lock.
notice.keyboard_connected: A keyboard was connected. It is locked too.
notice.mouse_connected: A mouse or touchpad was connected. It is locked too.
notice.engine_restarted: KeyClean's lock engine stopped and was restarted. Nothing is locked.
notice.liveness_unavailable: KeyClean can't check that the lock is still working. The timer and Ctrl+Alt+K still end it.
overlay.emergency.label: Emergency unlock:
overlay.emergency.hint: Press the shortcut to unlock immediately.
power.reason: KeyClean keeps the screen on during a cleaning session.
tray.status.problem: ● Something went wrong - open KeyClean for details
tray.status.unavailable: ● Engine unavailable - open KeyClean for details
overlay.mouseHint: Touchpad gestures such as scrolling and swiping still work during the lock.
tabs.label: KeyClean sections
duration.overMax: Presets longer than your maximum lock duration ({max}) are turned off. You can change it in Settings.
lock.lockedHint: Press Ctrl + Alt + K to unlock.
clean.note.keyboards: Every connected keyboard is locked during a session.
clean.note.touchpad: Touchpad follows the mouse; touchpad gestures may still get through.
settings.safety.title: Safety
settings.maxLock.label: Maximum lock duration
settings.maxLock.hint: A hard limit no lock can go past, whatever duration you pick. From {min} to {max} minutes.
settings.maxLock.invalid: Enter a whole number of minutes from {min} to {max}.
settings.maxLock.saved: Saved. The next lock uses the new limit.
devices.intro: The input devices Windows reports right now. This list updates when you plug a device in or out.
duration.customFormat: Enter whole minutes, and seconds from 0 to 59.
duration.customOutOfRange: That length is outside the range above.
